messages:
nisha_sec: Quick heads up — external security assessment onboarding is next Wednesday (09:00-13:00 PT). Need to lock down RBAC snapshot, KMS handoff plan, and an evidence upload flow. Can we align on minimal blast radius?

devon_ops: Thanks — setting aside ops bandwidth. Two asks: 1) ephemeral read-only role for assessors, 2) presigned S3 path + retention TTL for evidence.

devon_ops: Prefer to avoid adding persistent IAM perms. We can create a short-lived role and a scoped policy.

maria_platform: For audit logs: S3 export + CloudTrail lookup window. We should produce a single tarball of logs covering +48hrs around the test window and a short checklist for how we generated it. Retention: keep the tarball for 30 days by default.

sam_sre: Agreed. Suggest using ephemeral role via our internal sts-proxy. Example request pattern we'll accept: `POST /assessor-access` -> returns STS creds with scoped policy.

sam_sre: Also adding a KV for observability: set a label `assessment_id=ext-2026-03` so logs are easy to grep.

leo_research: KMS question: Assessors need to upload artifacts to S3 encrypted with our CMK. We should avoid giving them Decrypt/GenerateDataKey perms. So presigned PUT with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) would work, but presign for SSE-KMS requires a different flow. Alternative: use SSE-S3 or accept uploads to a bucket with default KMS encryption (which does not require requestor to have KMS perms).

nisha_sec: Good point. Let's go with bucket-default KMS encryption to avoid granting KMS:Encrypt to external accounts. We'll create a short doc snippet showing how presigned PUTs + SSE will be handled by ops.

security-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2026-1183 "External assessment — handoff & evidence pipe" (assignee: devon_ops, due: 2026-03-18). :white_check_mark:

terri_cs: Quick ask from CS: can we provide a simple evidence checklist (file types allowed, size limits, naming convention) so they can handoff artifacts cleanly?

devon_ops: Will do. Proposed naming: `<assessment_id>/<assessor>/<timestamp>_<sha256>.tgz`. Size limit: 10GB per object, multipart required.

maria_platform: Audit exports: command we will run: ```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time "2026-03-10T08:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-12T16:00:00Z" > ext-2026-03-cloudtrail.json
aws s3 cp ext-2026-03-cloudtrail.json s3://redwood-pt-exports/ext-2026-03/
``` Keep a SHA256 manifest next to it.

sam_sre: On retest coordination: if we find high/critical sev issues, ops will request a 72-hour mitigation window before retest scheduling. Otherwise target retest 7 days after initial report. Propose: triage call same day as report + daily standup until mitigations are in CI.

leo_research: Also adding a quick vuln triage matrix (severity -> required evidence -> owner). I'll attach in the ticket.

nisha_sec: Action items: devon to create ephemeral role + presigned flow doc, maria to produce audit export script and retention policy, leo to drop triage matrix, terri to draft evidence checklist. We'll run a 30m dry-run the day before. Anyone object?

terri_cs: No objections. I'll coordinate dry-run times with assessors.

devon_ops: I'll provision the role in staging and post the sample curl commands here by EOD.

nisha_sec: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me. :lock:
